Structurally, it forms part of the conditional relations analysis of the *Paṭṭhāna*, applying causal conditioning schemes to dhammas classified under the combination of the visible triad (*sanidassanattika*) and the dyad of states having roots to be abandoned by seeing (*dassanenapahātabbahetukaduka*) [SuttaCentral].
